verdict.rationale: Missive documents AI-generated drafts. Its AI integration can compose and reply to messages, its assistant (running on your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini key) and rules can create drafts, and external agents like Claude can draft replies over MCP into the drafts folder for you to review and send. Nothing in the evidence shows the AI learning or matching the user's personal voice and tone, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: drafts learned from or matched to the user's own writing style, tone/voice configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
